projectName.evidence: README.md title and backend/main.py FastAPI title

A5.evidence: Multi-feature backend routers and admin surface

A6.evidence: Agent infer-first path for Full guide

B1.value: A containerized Amazon-style web store where customers browse products, manage a cart and wishlist, checkout, and request refunds — with admins managing catalog, penalties, metrics, and exports.

B2.value: Course deliverable: FastAPI + Next.js stack running via Docker Compose, broad API coverage with pytest in CI, and demo accounts documented in README.

B3.value: Happy-path shopping, auth, cart, checkout, reviews, refunds, and admin flows work against JSON data. Currency conversion calls a live external API. CI unit/integration jobs use continue-on-error. No frontend test suite. Some auth tests mutate users.json on disk.

B4.value: Built: FastAPI routers/services/repositories, Next.js UI, JSON persistence, image scraper, admin metrics. Borrowed: FastAPI, Next.js, Tailwind, axios, bcrypt, pandas, BeautifulSoup, Amazon-derived product CSV, jsDelivr currency API.

B5.value: Keeping JSON files consistent across parallel features (cart, wishlist, transactions) without a real database, and coordinating a large router surface for a team codebase.

B6.value: Would defend Docker Compose as the single setup path. Would reconsider token-in-header auth without JWT expiry for a production deployment.

B7.value: Harden CI (fail on test errors), add frontend smoke tests, replace file-based auth test side effects, and document environment variables formally.

B8.value: Run docker compose up --build; open localhost:3000; pytest -m unit in backend/tests; Swagger at :8000/docs.

B9.value: Redact demo passwords from public guide; env names only (CORS_ORIGIN, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, PRODUCTS_FILE, USERS_FILE).

C_story.value: COSC 310 team capstone mimicking e-commerce flows with real-enough admin tooling and external integrations.

C_audience.value: Course markers and teammates who need to run the stack and understand what is implemented vs stubbed.

D_entrypoints.value: Backend: backend/main.py (uvicorn). Frontend: frontend/app/layout.tsx → pages under app/. Data: backend/data/*.json.

D_flow.value: Browser → Next.js pages → axios (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) → FastAPI router → service → repository → JSON file.

D_deps.value: Python: FastAPI, pytest, httpx, bcrypt, pandas, beautifulsoup4. Node: next, react, tailwind, axios, recharts.

D_failures.value: External currency API outages break converted prices; scraper depends on Amazon HTML shape; parallel writes to JSON risk corruption without DB transactions.

E_scheme.evidence: Full Libretto-style home per task brief

narrative.hook: A semester-long storefront exercise that ships as two containers and a folder of JSON databases.
narrative.proudMoment: Broad admin surface — refunds, penalties, metrics, export — on top of file-backed persistence.
